description: This Java class 'VoiceRecognition' is part of an Android application demonstrating speech recognition functionality. It provides UI elements like a button, a list view, and a spinner to initiate voice recognition, display recognition results, and select recognition languages. The class handles checking for recognition capability, starting the recognition activity, processing results, and managing supported language settings.

classes.name: VoiceRecognition
classes.description: Main activity class handling voice recognition UI and logic.

classes.name: SupportedLanguageBroadcastReceiver
classes.description: Inner class BroadcastReceiver to get supported language info from voice recognition service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, UI, and checks for recognition activity presence.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, starting voice recognition when button clicked.

methods.name: startVoiceRecognitionActivity
methods.description: Launches the voice recognition intent with specified parameters.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Processes results from voice recognition activity, updating UI with recognized speech.

methods.name: refreshVoiceSettings
methods.description: Requests supported language details from voice recognition service.

methods.name: updateSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Updates language selection spinner based on supported languages.
